reason: Infinite loop on invalid input; fixed in x/text v0.39.0, which needs Go 1.25. Reachable only through gorm's schema naming (static struct/column names). Upgrade is blocked on confirming the Go version of the EC2 build host. See docs/known-vulnerabilities.md

Memory exhaustion in a TLS SERVER from crafted Encrypted Client Hello messages; fixed in Go 1.26.9 / 1.27.2, no Go 1.25 fix. This code is only a TLS client (mysql driver to the Proxy). Needs a Go >= 1.26 build host. See docs/known-vulnerabilities.md

crypto/x509 denylist of known-untrusted intermediate certificates (Certificate.Verify); fixed in Go 1.26.10 / 1.27.3, no Go 1.25 fix. The lab uses tls=skip-verify (no verification). Needs a Go >= 1.26 build host. See docs/known-vulnerabilities.md
